reason: The hypothesis combines the known role of grain-boundary diffusion in nanocrystalline HEAs (P5, P12, P36) with the formation of a protective Al2O3 scale (P8, P13) and applies it to a new, specific alloy (Al0.2Co1.5CrFeNi1.5Ti0.3) under a controlled comparison of oxidizing vs. reducing environments, which none of the passages directly propose. The contrast between oxidizing and reducing conditions and the prediction of internal oxidation under reducing atmospheres is a non-trivial extension not found in the cited literature.
